message.content:
**Yes – you can file a noise complaint in Atlanta, but it’s handled through the city’s public‑safety and code‑enforcement offices rather than the city council itself.** Below is a quick guide on how to do it, plus the key contacts and resources you’ll need. --- ## 1. Where to File a Noise Complaint | Agency | Typical Role | How to Contact | |--------|--------------|----------------| | **Atlanta Police Department (APD)** | First line for all noise complaints, especially if the noise is ongoing or involves illegal activity. | • Phone: **404‑656‑3111** (24 h “311” line)
• Online: [APD 311 Portal](https://www.atlantaga.gov/311)
• Email: 311@atlantaga.gov | | **City of Atlanta Code Enforcement / Public Safety** | Handles non‑emergency noise complaints, code violations, and enforcement of the city’s noise ordinance. | • Phone: **404‑656‑3111** (same 311 line)
• Online: [Noise Complaint Form](https://www.atlantaga.gov/311)
• Email: 311@atlantaga.gov | | **City Hall – City Council Office** | Not the primary handler, but you can bring the issue to the council if you want policy changes or broader community action. | • Phone: **404‑656‑3111** (for general inquiries)
• Address: 55 Marietta Street NW, Atlanta, GA 30303 | > **Tip:** If the noise is an emergency (e.g., a fire alarm, a potential crime, or a dangerous situation), call **911** immediately. --- ## 2. How to File a Complaint Online 1. Visit the **[Atlanta 311 Portal](https://www.atlantaga.gov/311)**. 2. Select **“Noise”** from the list of services. 3. Fill out the form with: * Your contact information (optional but helpful for follow‑up). * Date & time of the noise. * Description of the source (e.g., construction, party, loud music). * Any evidence (photos, videos, audio recordings). 4. Submit the form. You’ll receive a confirmation number and a brief summary of next steps. --- ## 3. What Happens Next? * **APD** will dispatch an officer to investigate if the noise violates the city’s noise ordinance or if it’s part of a larger disturbance. * **Code Enforcement** may issue a citation or order a remedy if the noise violates local regulations. * **City Council** may review the complaint if you request it, especially if you believe the ordinance needs updating or if you’re seeking a broader community solution. --- ## 4. Key Legal Reference * **Atlanta Noise Ordinance** – Governs permissible noise levels and times. * Link: [Atlanta Noise Ordinance PDF](https://www.atlantaga.gov/government/departments/city-hall/department-of-public-safety/noise-ordinance) * Highlights: * Residential areas: 10 pm–7 am (noisy activities prohibited). * Commercial areas: 11 pm–6 am (some exceptions). * Construction: 7 am–7 pm (unless otherwise permitted). --- ## 5. Quick Contact Summary | Service | Phone | Email | Website | |---------|-------|-------|---------| | **Atlanta Police 311** | 404‑656‑3111 | 311@atlantaga.gov | [311 Portal](https://www.atlantaga.gov/311) | | **City Hall / City Council** | 404‑656‑3111 | 311@atlantaga.gov | [City Hall](https://www.atlantaga.gov) | | **Noise Ordinance PDF** | N/A | N/A | [Noise Ordinance](https://www.atlantaga.gov/government/departments/city-hall/department-of-public-safety/noise-ordinance) | --- ### Bottom Line - **Yes, you can report noise in Atlanta.** - Use the **311 line** or the **online portal** to file a complaint. - The **city council** can be involved if you want to push for policy changes, but the initial handling is done by the **Police Department** or **Code Enforcement**. If you need more detailed guidance—such as how to document the noise or what evidence is most useful—just let me know!
